# Olympic Mountain Ice Cream

> Family-owned maker of super-premium, small-batch ice cream and sorbet since 1984. The business started in the Skokomish Valley and, since November 2026, makes its ice cream at a new creamery and scoop shop at the Port of Shelton in Shelton, Washington.

## Visit the creamery and scoop shop

- Address: 130 W Corporate Rd, Shelton, WA 98584
- Hours: 10am to 6pm, 7 days a week
- Phone: 360-426-0696
- In store: 16 flavors for scoops, plus pints to take home
- [Get directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=130+W+Corporate+Rd,+Shelton,+WA+98584)

## Pages

- [Home](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/): flavors, the new creamery, where to find the ice cream, the family story, reviews, FAQ and contact
- [Flavor library](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/#flavors): 161 ice creams and 77 sorbets, searchable, with custom flavors made to order
- [Visit](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/#visit): the creamery and scoop shop at the Port of Shelton
- [Where to find](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/#pints): more than 200 restaurants and markets around Puget Sound, with a map
- [FAQ](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/#faq): allergens, buying tubs, public sales and delivery areas
- [Contact](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/#contact): send a note about a new flavor idea, a business opportunity or an event
- [Wholesale ordering](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/wholesale): order for a restaurant, café or market

## Wholesale

- Sizes and prices (USD): pint $6.75, quart $13.25, 1.5 gallon tub $49.50, 3 gallon tub $95.80, gelato pan $39.00
- Orders are placed on the [wholesale ordering page](https://olympicmountainicecream.pages.dev/wholesale). No payment is taken online; the creamery confirms availability, pricing and the delivery day directly.
- Direct delivery: around Hood Canal and Highway 101 north to Lilliwaup, around Olympia, north on I-5 as far as Edmonds, and east to Redmond and Issaquah
- Further out, through distributors: US Foods, Food Services of America, Liberty Dairy, Medosweet and Dairy Fresh Farms

## Good to know

- The base ice cream contains no gluten, eggs or soy, but some inclusions do. Call about specific flavors.
- All sorbets are dairy free and egg free.
- Tours of the facility are not offered.
